method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: U.S. tariff-hike threats pile pressure on partners to sign trade deals
Equities.summary: The U.S. planned a fresh tariff salvo on 14 trading partners, while offering some countries lower rates if they secure trade deals with Washington.
Equities.reason: Large-scale U.S. tariff threats raise policy uncertainty and potential hit to global trade and earnings — negative for broad equity risk sentiment and cyclical exporters. High relevance as this is a macro policy shock.

Equities.title: How Trump’s latest tariff moves hand India an edge over rival Asian exporters
Equities.summary: Proposed tariffs of 18% on Bangladesh, Cambodia, Thailand, and 20% on China and Vietnam, subject to their respective trade deals, offer India a competitive advantage.
Equities.reason: Trade actions create a relative winner in India vs. other Asian exporters — modestly positive for Indian equities/exports flows while reinforcing regional winners/losers theme.

Equities.title: Tech stocks set for worst month in four years as volatility surges
Equities.summary: All-powerful AI trade has been eclipsed by wild swings in a market struggling to price future earnings
Equities.reason: Broad, sector-defining negative: AI-led leadership is facing large drawdowns and valuation repricing, elevating market volatility and pressuring overall equity multiples — high relevance to market regime.

Equities.title: S&P warns Nvidia credit rating could be cut over 'rising' management and governance risk
Equities.summary: S&P Global Ratings said Nvidia's credit rating could be cut by one notch as it flagged "rising" management and governance risk at the chipmaker.
Equities.reason: Credit-rating pressure on Nvidia amplifies governance and concentration risks around the AI trade; negative for tech-sector sentiment and single-stock/ETF positioning.

Equities.title: Nvidia Halts Sales to Southeast Asia as U.S. Tightens China Restrictions
Equities.reason: Operational/shipping curbs tied to US export controls hit Nvidia distribution and the AI supply chain — tangible downside for AI hardware availability and clustered tech exposure.

Equities.title: Chinese shares soar after Beijing signals more support
Equities.summary: CSI 300 index jumps more than 4% in afternoon trading
Equities.reason: Explicit state-market support lifted mainland equities — positive regional equity impulse and liquidity/backstop narrative for China risk assets.

Equities.title: China Tech’s Earnings Offer Little Relief in Worst-Ever Year
Equities.reason: Weak earnings in China tech reinforce downside pressure on the sector despite policy support; signals fundamental strain in a key regional equity cohort.

Rates.title: Is the Fed ready for its next fight?
Rates.summary: US central bank officials face a three-dimensional tussle over inflation, AI and guidance
Rates.reason: Discussion of the Fed's policy stance and the trade-offs (inflation vs growth vs guidance) reinforces a higher-for-longer narrative for US rates. Markets likely interpret persistent inflation risks and tighter guidance as upward pressure on yields (negative for bond prices). High relevance given Fed

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, October 27-28, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, October 27-28, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes are direct signals about Fed policy deliberations. Even without inventing content, these minutes typically drive yield repricing; given the current market context (focus on inflation and potential persistence), the minutes are treated as supportive of higher-for-longer rates, applying s

Rates.title: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on October 19 and October 28, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on October 19 and October 28, 2026
Rates.reason: Discount rate meeting minutes speak to operational and lender-of-last-resort considerations that can influence funding and term premia. Interpreted as modestly hawkish in the current context (potential for tighter liquidity/ongoing vigilance), implying some upward pressure on yields.

Rates.title: Breaking: Japan’s Tokyo CPI inflation climbs 2.8% in November
Rates.summary: The headline Tokyo Consumer Price Index (CPI) for November rose 2.8% YoY as compared to 2.7% in the previous month (revised from 2.8%), the Statistics Bureau of Japan showed on Friday.
Rates.reason: Stronger Tokyo CPI points to renewed upside inflation pressure in Japan, which can push market expectations for BoJ policy normalisation and higher JGB yields. This is negative for bond prices in Japan and can spill into global rates via risk premia and carry flows.

Rates.title: IMF Urges RBA to Be Ready to Tighten Further If Prices Worsen
Rates.reason: IMF advice for the RBA to be prepared to tighten implies the risk of further rate hikes in Australia if inflation deteriorates. Markets may price higher Australian yields and wider global rate repricing risk; direct relevance to APAC rates and broader risk premia.

Rates.title: French preliminary inflation at 3.2% in November
Rates.reason: Higher-than-desired French inflation supports the narrative of persistent euro-area inflation, which keeps ECB policy on guard and sustains upward pressure on European sovereign yields. Moderately relevant for EUR rates.

Rates.title: Meeting of 28-29 October 2026
Rates.reason: ECB meeting accounts are a primary input for euro-area rate expectations. In the current environment (inflation vigilance globally), these minutes are interpreted as modestly hawkish, supporting higher yields in Europe and globally through policy signalling.

FX.title: British Pound remains on the back foot vs USD as BoE rate hike bets limit downside
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair trades with a negative bias for the second straight day, hovering around the 1.3100 mark during the Asian session on Friday amid a modest US Dollar (USD) uptick.
FX.reason: GBP/USD trading with a negative bias => GBP softening vs USD (USD bid). This is a direct USD-centric FX move; BoE hike bets limiting downside are a partial offset but the dominant near-term narrative is GBP weakness vs USD.

FX.title: Euro weakens to near 1.0950 on Fed hike outlook, de Cos poised to lead ECB
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair loses ground to near 1.0960 during the early Asian trading hours on Friday. The Euro (EUR) remains on the defensive against the US Dollar (USD) after falling to its lowest since April 2025 earlier in the week. The US Thanksgiving holiday keeps
FX.reason: Article notes EUR/USD losing ground on Fed hike outlook — explicit USD-driven downside for the Euro. ECB leadership mention adds policy uncertainty, increasing FX relevance.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index weakens below 104.00 as AI concerns simmer
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 103.70 in the early European trading hours on Friday.
FX.reason: DXY weakness is an explicit USD shock — USD down tends to support EUR/GBP/AUD/JPY etc. This is a broad FX signal (higher market-wide relevance).

FX.title: Dollar Set for Longest Winning Run Since 2024 on AI Risk
FX.reason: High-profile Bloomberg take: AI-related risk is driving demand for USD (safe-haven/yield) -> pushes dollar stronger. Significant macro narrative that directly argues for USD strength (negative for non-USD pairs).

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Inflation strengthens case for December hike – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank strategist Volkmar Baur notes that Tokyo inflation remains above the Bank of Japan’s (BoJ) 2% target, with core prices at 2.5% year-on-year. He argues that inflation appears to be settling slightly above target and that producer price pressures are
FX.reason: Stronger inflation and rising odds of BoJ tightening imply JPY appreciation vs USD. This is a direct FX-native fundamental catalyst for Yen strength (rate differential channel).

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar advances vs USD, retakes 0.5500 after NZ election results
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair catches aggressive bids during the Asian session on Friday, hitting a fresh weekly top in the last hour and looking to extend the momentum further beyond the 0.5500 psychological mark.
FX.reason: NZD/USD showing clear bid after election outcome — direct FX move tied to domestic political event. Solid regional/EMFX signal but more localized than major G10 flows (moderate relevance).

FX.title: Indian Rupee corrects further as renewed Hormuz risk lifts oil prices
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends correction further against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday. The USD/INR pair recovers further to near 92.75 as a sharp recovery in oil prices weighs on the Indian currency.
FX.reason: USD/INR rising = INR weakness driven by oil/Hormuz risk. Direct EMFX move tied to commodity risk; relevant to EM/commodity-linked currencies but smaller footprint than G10.

FX.title: China stocks, yuan rally after Beijing vows stronger market support
FX.reason: Policy pledge from Beijing boosting risk assets and CNY — yuan strength versus USD is an explicit FX transmission from direct state support for markets, raising regional FX appetite.

Commodities.title: WTI advances further beyond $85.00, over one-week top amid renewed supply disruption fears
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – attracts buyers for the fourth consecutive day on Friday, prolonging this week's goodish recovery from the $78.85 region, or its lowest level since August 10.
Commodities.reason: Direct, market-moving oil price action driven by renewed supply-disruption fears; strong relevance to WTI fundamentals and risk premium.

Commodities.title: Saudi Energy Ministry says strike on Jazan refinery halts some operations
Commodities.summary: The Saudi Energy Ministry said an attack on Saudi Arabia’s oil refinery in the southern province of Jazan temporarily halted some of the facility’s operations and killed one worker, Bloomberg reported on Thursday.
Commodities.reason: Physical disruption at a major oil facility increases near-term oil supply risk and risk premium; directly bullish for crude.

Commodities.title: Oil flows through Middle East chokepoints increased in the third quarter
Commodities.summary: Collective oil shipments through key chokepoints around the Middle East increased by 19% in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26), according to our recently published Global Energy Security Data.
Commodities.reason: Higher shipments through chokepoints imply stronger flows and lower short-term bottleneck risk — modestly bearish for oil; data release with limited immediate price impact.

Commodities.title: U.S. natural gas inventories end injection season above normal levels
Commodities.summary: Working natural gas in storage in the Lower 48 states ended the natural gas injection season at 3,810 billion cubic feet (Bcf), exceeding the five-year average by almost 2%, according to estimates based on data from our Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report releas
Commodities.reason: Above-normal storage levels increase downside risk for US natural gas prices heading into winter/next season; directly relevant to gas supply/demand balance.

Commodities.title: Gold declines to near $3,550 amid hawkish Fed expectations
Commodities.summary: Gold price edges lower to around $3,565 during the early Asian session on Friday. The precious metal faces some selling pressure amid inflation concerns and expectations of a US Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate hike next month.
Commodities.reason: Fed rate-hike expectations raise the opportunity cost of holding gold; direct macro driver for the metal, material for positioning.

Commodities.title: Gold extends gains to $3,650 as weak USD offsets Fed hike bets and geopolitical headwinds
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) builds on its steady intraday ascent, climbing beyond $3,650 during Friday’s Asian session and recovering further from the September 2025 lows it touched earlier this week.
Commodities.reason: USD weakness and geopolitical risk are supporting prices; countervailing to Fed-driven downside — relevant but intraday and less decisive than macro-rate signals.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD surges to near $43.75 as US Dollar remains in corrective phase
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its two-day recovery on Friday, surging almost 5% to near $43.75 in the Asian trade. The white metal outperforms after a long underperformance as the US Dollar’s (USD) rally has come to a halt.
Commodities.reason: Strong short-term move tied to USD dynamics and metals rebalancing; meaningful for silver positioning given the size of the move.

Commodities.title: Copper Rebounds From 11-Month Low on Return of Risk Appetite
Commodities.reason: Recovery from multi-month lows signals improved risk appetite/demand expectations — directly positive for copper and base-metals sentiment.

Commodities.title: Congo Closes on Top Copper Supplier Chile as Exports Soar Again
Commodities.reason: Surging Congo exports increase copper supply prospects, which can weigh on prices — an important supply-side datapoint but more structural/medium-term than an immediate shock.

Commodities.title: Congo Gold Trader Plans Two Refineries with 68-Ton Capacity
Commodities.reason: Planned refinery capacity expansion could add to regional gold supply/refining throughput over time; relevant to fundamentals but limited near-term market impact.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETFs are bleeding cash and the Fed is unlikely to help
Crypto.reason: ETF outflows are a direct liquidity/flow drain from BTC markets; combined with a hawkish Fed backdrop (no macro liquidity backstop) this strengthens a bearish narrative for crypto prices and institutional demand.

Crypto.title: Binance says customer withdrawals are fully restored, four weeks after the $6.3 billion hack
Crypto.reason: Restoring withdrawals eases immediate liquidity/access concerns and reduces short-term counterparty risk premium, supporting market functioning—but the large hack itself remains a material negative for trust.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin’s dormant supply rises, a behavior seen during previous bear-market bottoming phases
Crypto.reason: Rising dormant supply suggests accumulation/less selling pressure and is a commonly-cited on-chain signal for market bottoming—constructive for BTC sentiment and medium-term price prospects.

Crypto.title: Bill to lock up U.S. government bitcoin for 20 years advances to full House
Crypto.reason: If enacted, locking up government-held BTC would materially remove supply from circulation and could be a durable bullish structural driver for BTC; political uncertainty tempers relevance but the potential impact is meaningful.

Crypto.title: $7 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday, and the biggest bets look starkly different from October
Crypto.reason: Large options expiries can drive short-term volatility and directional pressure around key strikes; market-structure flow risk raises near-term execution and gamma-driven move risk for BTC.

Crypto.title: Over 1,000 Bitcoin miners were tricked into working for a thief by a fake internet route
Crypto.reason: A large-scale BGP-style hijack of miners exposes network/operator vulnerabilities and undermines confidence in mining security and continuity—negative for BTC sentiment and perceived network resilience.

Crypto.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody suffers data breach, exposing client information
Crypto.reason: Custody-provider data breaches hit institutional trust and onboarding, increasing counterparty and operational risk premiums for crypto services—material negative for institutional adoption and flows.

Crypto.title: Spain gives anti-laundering unit power to freeze crypto accounts without a judge
Crypto.reason: Expanded AML powers and administrative account freezes increase regulatory enforcement risk and reduce custody/usage certainty in a major EU market—negative for on-chain activity and institutional confidence.

Crypto.title: Hong Kong-based crypto trading firm Auros is winding down operations
Crypto.reason: The wind-down of a major trading firm can reduce liquidity and market-making capacity in crypto venues, raising execution costs and volatility—negative for orderly markets.

Crypto.title: Ethereum's much-awaited Glamsterdam upgrade cleared for December test. Here's what to know
Crypto.reason: A major Ethereum upgrade moving into testing reduces technical uncertainty and supports ETH development/utility narratives—positive for ETH-specific demand and developer confidence.

Crypto.title: Zcash developers want to phase out older privacy system as a precaution against future attacks
Crypto.reason: Phasing out an older privacy system forces user migration and short-term on-chain movement of sizeable balances (~$300m), creating technical risk and potential sell pressure; precautionary but lower market-wide relevance.

Crypto.title: Ripple is worth $90 a share to one fund and $300 to another, SEC filings show
Crypto.reason: Divergent institutional valuations for XRP reflect idiosyncratic views on legal/regulatory resolution and token economics; limited market-wide impact but relevant to XRP-specific flows and investor sentiment.
